articles.title: Topeka West defends home court, beats Shawnee Heights in city matchup
articles.summary: The Topeka West boys basketball team secured a home victory against Shawnee Heights, winning 67-57 on Friday night. This in-city matchup saw the Chargers defend their court successfully. Prince Lassiter notably contributed, leading Topeka West to this decisive win in local high school sports.

articles.title: Retired Air Force officer shot by unidentified assailants at restaurant in Lucknow shopping complex
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently engaged in a phone call with Venezuela's Acting President Delcy Rodríguez. During their discussion, both leaders emphasized strengthening and expanding bilateral ties between India and Venezuela. This diplomatic engagement highlights India's ongoing efforts to foster international partnerships and maintain robust foreign relations, which is crucial for global influence and strategic interests.
